**How long must we keep this, and when are we obliged to destroy it?**


> Applying the retention schedule: what is kept, for how long, where it goes when it leaves active use, and what must be defensibly destroyed. Retention has two failure modes with opposite consequences — discarding something a regulator will ask for, and keeping personal data past the point we were allowed to.
